# llms.txt — remote-agent-kit index for humans and coding agents

> remote-agent-kit: Terraform + Ansible + Makefile kit that provisions a
> hardened Hetzner VPS (cx33 x86, Ubuntu 24.04), joins it to Tailscale, and
> configures Hermes Agent (Telegram gateway, Perch phone-client API, Agent of
> Empires multi-agent coding, backups). MIT licensed. No servers are built
> here; this repo configures YOUR server. Secrets live in `.env` only.

## Start here

- README.md — architecture diagram, quickstart (`make init/plan/apply/deploy/pair/doctor`), layout, safety
- docs/prereqs.md — the 7 things to gather first (tokens, keys, bot, model)
- docs/ops-runbook.md — daily commands, updates, failure-mode table, teardown
- docs/alternatives.md — exe.dev / boat / Vercel Eve evaluation + when to use each
- docs/costs.md — pay-only-for-the-box truth table + specs + why x86, why disk-not-RAM
- docs/privacy-considerations.md — threat model: keys are shells, QR is a credential
- docs/adr/0001-hetzner-tailscale.md — why hybrid over PaaS/plain VPS
- docs/adr/0002-terraform-ansible.md — why this automation split (Gall's Law)
- docs/telegram-setup.md — BotFather + allow-list walkthrough (5 min)
- docs/tailscale-perch.md — access matrix (SSH/terminal/Telegram/Perch), Tailscale $0 facts + alternatives, pairing, lockout recovery
- docs/usage.md — THE daily driver's guide: terminal/phone/AoE workshop, per-CLI auth, architecture map, cheat sheet

## Operate

- Makefile — every command (`make help`); deploy reads `.env`, never commits it
- scripts/start.sh — THE easy button: deps, validated key prompts, writes config, plan approval, full run, resumable
- scripts/finish.sh — completes the one-click box ON the server (Tailscale join, model, optional Telegram, services)
- deploy/hetzner-cloud-init.yaml — one-click first-boot (no secrets inside, ever); pasted via #include
- .env.example — all secrets with CHANGEME placeholders; copy to `.env`, chmod 600
- scripts/preflight.sh — Murphy's gate: tools + filled secrets + SSH key, before money moves
- scripts/doctor.sh — 7-point live health check (read-only); appends JSONL to logs/doctor.log
- scripts/backup.sh — pull newest server tarball over Tailscale
- scripts/ck-replica.sh — exact replica of local CK state to the box (WAL-safe .backup, verify by counts) + path-remap via ck-remap.py
- scripts/rollback.sh — restore server from tarball (snapshots first, always asks)
- scripts/pair.sh — pairing instructions (QR itself comes from Perch's pair.sh on the server)
- scripts/perch-web.sh — serve the Perch web export on this Mac (needs tailnet + box CORS origin)
- scripts/repo_check.sh — secret scan + bash/YAML syntax + terraform fmt (also CI)

## Provision (Terraform — Hetzner only)

- terraform/versions.tf, providers.tf — hcloud ~> 1.49, token from var/env
- terraform/variables.tf — server_type default cx33 (x86 ONLY, never cax ARM: gateway crash-loops)
- terraform/server.tf — edge-closed firewall (SSH-from-your-IP, ICMP; no 80/443), ssh key, server + cloud-init
- terraform/cloud-init.yaml.tftpl — first-boot only: non-root user, key-only SSH, base packages
- terraform/outputs.tf — public IPv4 (bootstrap), ids, tailscale hint
- terraform/terraform.tfvars.example — copy to terraform.tfvars (gitignored)

## Configure (Ansible — works on ANY Ubuntu 24.04 x86 box, not just Hetzner)

- ansible/playbook.yml — 7 idempotent roles, feature-toggled in group_vars/all.yml
- ansible/roles/common — apt, swap, key-only SSH, UFW deny-incoming, fail2ban, unattended-upgrades
- ansible/roles/tailscale — up with auth key, verify tailnet SSH, THEN bind sshd to tailnet IP; operator grant + HTTPS serve of the API (iOS requires https MagicDNS); UFW 22/443 tailnet-only
- ansible/roles/hermes — installer (~6.6 GB), API env 0600, keygen, UFW tailnet-only 8642, doctor
- ansible/roles/telegram — polling bot, mandatory allow-list, non-interactive install workaround, linger, health wait
- ansible/roles/perch — dashboard 9119 service (tailnet-only), pinned session token, ntfy hook plugin
- ansible/roles/aoe — Docker + Agent of Empires from GitHub releases, `aoe agents` verify
- ansible/roles/toolchain — uv/pnpm/rust/pip/compose/build-essential, all verified answering
- ansible/roles/herdr — OFF by default; installs Herdr binary for terminal-first operators
- ansible/roles/backups — nightly cron (hermes backup + tarball + optional age), retention, snapshot reminder

## Rules (non-negotiable, enforced by repo_check.sh + CI)

- Never commit `.env`, `terraform.tfvars`, `ansible/inventory/hosts.yml`, `*.tfstate`, age keys
- Placeholders are `CHANGEME`; anything matching live-secret patterns fails CI
- No `--privileged` / host-network containers; agents run sandboxed
- Re-running `make deploy` must be a no-op (idempotency); cloud-init runs once, Ansible runs forever
